My dearest Vikas Khanna, what a joy it was to visit your restaurant Bungalow! The warmth, love and अपनापन you showered on me and my team made us feel we were back home in India. ❤️🇮🇳
I am so proud of you, brother. You have made Bungalow a name to be celebrated, through your extraordinary food and the Indian traditions you have preserved with so much care and pride. There is a little bit of home in every corner.❤️🥹❤️
And what can I possibly say about your food? You are the chef. I am an actor. My very happy expressions after every single dish I tasted should be enough of a review! 😄
What touched me most was that you remain so grounded, affectionate and loving. Behind all that brilliance is a heart that makes everyone feel welcome.❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹
God bless you, my brother. May you keep making India proud and feeding people with food and love! Jai Ho! 🙏❤️ @TheVikasKhanna @YoSwaroop @Rajenderpahl
